title: Product Service Provider's Obligation to Issue Adequate Instructions

content.scenario: A consumer, Priya, purchased a hair straightener from a manufacturer that did not provide adequate instructions on how to use the product safely. As a result, Priya suffered burns while using the straightener.
content.outcome: The manufacturer is liable for not issuing adequate instructions or warnings to prevent harm. The consumer (Priya) can file a complaint against the manufacturer for product liability, as the service provider did not meet their obligation to provide safe usage instructions.

user_queries: What are the obligations of a product service provider regarding instructions?
Can a consumer file a complaint for inadequate instructions?
What happens if a product causes harm due to lack of instructions?
